data.exact_reserve_text: During 2016 we were able to release prior year reserves of $180.2m (2015: $177.6m). Our specialty lines division increased their reserve releases as the post recession portfolio from 2012 onwards matures; a trend which we expect to see continuing. This counter-balanced lower releases on short tail classes where the mechanical effect that reduced margins have on reserve releases is now visable.
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reported a gross prior-year reserve release of $180.2m in 2016 (2015: $177.6m). Releases were driven by favourable claims development and maturing post-recession business (notably from 2012 onwards) with particularly large releases in specialty lines, partially offset by reduced releases in some short-tail classes due to margin compression. The overall claims environment was described as favourable with modest natural catastrophe notifications.
raw_causal_phrases: During 2016 we were able to release prior year reserves of $180.2m (2015: $177.6m).
Our specialty lines division increased their reserve releases as the post recession portfolio from 2012 onwards matures; a trend which we expect to see continuing.
This counter-balanced lower releases on short tail classes where the mechanical effect that reduced margins have on reserve releases is now visable.
Overall, the claims environment has been favourable during 2016 with a relatively modest incidence of natural catastrophe claims notifications.
data.data_quality_notes: Prior year movement ($180.2m) sourced from Managing Agent narrative that explicitly states 'released prior year reserves of $180.2m' and is treated as a GROSS figure. No separate 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' gross column was found in the technical notes; technical reserve reconciliation rows show total movements (including current year) and were therefore not used. Claims development table exists but is presented as loss-ratio percentages and current gross liabilities by underwriting year; the narrative gross release figure was used as primary source.
